description: This file implements a configuration flag handler for ADB (Android Debug Bridge) settings within the Cuttlefish project. It defines the AdbConfigFlagImpl class that manages command-line flags related to ADB modes, processes flag inputs, and generates help XML. It also sets default modes and logs information if ADB is not enabled.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdbConfigFlag interface, managing ADB-related command-line flags, processing their values, and generating help documentation.

methods.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the flag with help text and getter/setter logic for the 'adb_mode' flag.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the flag implementation.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for this flag feature, specifically the associated ConfigFlag.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to set ADB modes and connection flags, with default settings and logging.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Generates XML help documentation for the flags.
